mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for future corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the probability of central bank intervention and triggers a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.0%, or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 70% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which signals a contractionary economic trajectory and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in joint regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 over the past month indicates a contraction in real output, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO < 95.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.0% and the federal funds rate remains below 0.5%, the central bank is perceived as accommodative despite rising prices, leading to expectations of future rate hikes and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between CPIAUCSL > 2.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5 fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in RSAFS and HOUST fails to generate positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a predictive model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 over the past month signals labor market weakness, which increases the likelihood of monetary policy accommodation and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 50000, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past four quarters, combined with stagnant or declining residential construction (HOUST), indicates a deepening demand slump, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression framework.
